nits.issue: Lower/mixed-case exempt codes after a labelled/R figure are NOT parked, and the batch email shows only 'ZAR n' (no original text excerpt exists anywhere), so a foreign amount passes as an approvable 'ZAR 100.00' with no visible original currency. Upper-case and glued forms (100 TRY, 100rub, 100try, R100 ALL, MAD) still park. Author-typed text only; owner approves; money moves in ZAR to a ZAR beneficiary.
